MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "I buy cables to connect particular devices. The USB-C cables would not meet the Micro USB, Mini USB, and 30-pin needs shown in my purchases.",
    "My memory cards and card reader support removable storage; an internal SSD or M.2 enclosure would require a different need that I have not expressed.",
    "My photography tripods and lens cap do not mean I want home surveillance cameras.",
    "Owning a Fire tablet, TV, and DVD player does not give me a current reason to add Alexa speakers, smart displays, or a streaming device. None of these recommendations felt useful enough to choose now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been treated as interest in new electronic devices generally, although I often buy practical accessories for equipment I already own.",
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been stretched into an interest in several Alexa products, without evidence that I want voice-controlled devices.",
    "Products that involve storage or cameras seem to have been treated as interchangeable despite serving very different purposes."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Exact connector and device compatibility matter to me: a cable is useful only if it fits the equipment I need to connect.",
    "I repeatedly buy accessories that help me use, organize, support, or maintain existing equipment, including mounts, memory-card holders, power strips, and a lens cap.",
    "My repeated SD and MicroSD purchases point toward removable-media needs rather than an internal computer upgrade.",
    "My car accessories address mounting, power, and connections; they do not establish a desire for a voice assistant."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in electronics but missed that I usually want compatible, practical accessories for devices I already use."
}
